assumptions: Flat, dry track with spatially uniform grip.
Quasi-steady point-mass kart; transient yaw and load transfer are not modeled.
Power, aerodynamic drag and rolling resistance are modelled; the declared top speed acts as a hard cap rather than a tapered target.
The path is a locally optimized minimum-bending baseline, not a global minimum-time line.
